Title: Verify an unauthenticated browser is sent to the sign-in page for Home
Step Action: Open a browser on a machine or profile that has no Windows or SSO session for the service
Step Expected: No D2R2 session cookie exists

Step Action: Open the D2R2 Home page address
Step Expected: The browser is redirected to the sign-in page (VLAServices Login) instead of the D2R2 Home page

Step Action: Check the page content
Step Expected: No D2R2 menu, search box or profile data is displayed

Step Action: Check the address bar
Step Expected: The address is the sign-in page address and not the requested D2R2 page

Step Action: Sign in with a valid D2R2 account
Step Expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed
